Method notes

  • Nominal quality 90 means each encoder's own knob; the measured PSNR is what makes the comparison honest.
  • PYRA lossless/lossy numbers come from this Python package; the other formats come from ImageMagick 6.9 and ffmpeg+libjxl 7 at their default settings plus the flags shown.
  • Encode time includes process startup for external tools and is not an algorithm-only benchmark.
  • The corpus is the Kodak PhotoCD set; nothing in this repository was tuned on it.
